summary: Testing P3b (HttpOnly Cookie Auth) and P3c (Sign-off Gate) features. All 26 security tests pass (25 pre-existing + 2 new P3c). Backend cookie auth flows verified via curl. Frontend login and MFA flows verified via Playwright.

minor.issue: _clear_auth_cookies() calls delete_cookie without secure=True. The original cookie was set with secure=True. Mismatch may cause some browsers to not clear the cookie correctly. Should add secure=True to delete_cookie calls.

action_items: Fix _clear_auth_cookies() in auth.py to include secure=True and httponly=True in delete_cookie calls to match original cookie attributes
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py _clear_auth_cookies: response.delete_cookie() missing secure=True and httponly=True flags — when original cookie was set with these, the delete MUST mirror them or some strict browsers won't clear the cookie.

context_for_next_testing_agent: P3b and P3c features fully verified. 26/26 security tests pass. rca_of_issue: test_signoff_allowed_when_all_reviewed was failing because _set_reviewed() called database.create_pool() in a new event loop inside an xdist worker that had already created a pool.
